formats.news60: AI News in 60s – what happened, why it matters, what comes next
formats.explainer: Explainer – how something works, with one strong analogy
formats.tool: Useful AI – one tool or use case and what it means for the viewer
formats.myth: Myth vs. fact – a common belief, then the surprising truth
formats.list: Top 3 – three quick, concrete items with a payoff at the end
formats.future: What this means for you – job, money, daily life, grounded in facts

title.description: Video title in the channel language, max 70 characters, specific and curiosity-driven

hook.description: Spoken first sentence in the channel language, max 14 words

angle.description: GERMAN: our specific angle in one sentence

whyNow.description: GERMAN: why this works right now, citing a number from the signals

demand.description: Expected audience demand from the signals

hook.description: On-screen hook text for the first 2.5 seconds, max 6 words, no emojis

narration.description: Spoken text for this scene, 1–3 short sentences. Write numbers the way they should be spoken.

visual.description: Prompt for the AI video generator: one continuous cinematic shot, symbolic, no text, no real people or logos

caption.description: Instagram caption: 2–4 short lines, value first, ends with a question to the viewer. No hashtags here.

claims.description: Every factual claim made in the narration, one per item

why.description: GERMAN: one sentence why this script should perform

pass.description: true if no serious problem remains after your fixes

fixedNarration.description: Full corrected narration for that scene, or empty if no safe fix exists
